resources.string: Termux is not installed. Install it from F-Droid or Google Play.
For your security, OOPBoT only runs in the official F-Droid or Google Play build of Termux, and the Termux on this phone is neither. Reinstall Termux from F-Droid or Google Play.
OOPBoT isn\'t allowed to run commands in Termux. In OOPBoT\'s app info, go to Permissions → Additional permissions → Run commands in Termux environment → Allow, then retry.
Termux blocked OOPBoT\'s commands. Run the setup command in Termux, then retry.
Android blocked starting Termux in the background. Open OOPBoT and retry.
Open Termux once and let it finish installing.
OOPBoT engine is missing in Termux. Run the setup command in Termux, then retry.
OOPBoT engine can\'t run or is damaged. Run `%1$s` in Termux, then retry.
OOPBoT\'s Termux helper did not receive its token. Retry.
OOPBoT\'s Termux helper exited with status %1$d before connecting.
Termux did not respond in time. Open Termux once, then retry.
The connection to Termux closed unexpectedly. Retry.
Termux stopped while starting OOPBoT\'s helper. Retry.
Termux couldn\'t run OOPBoT\'s helper. Retry.
Termux was reinstalled, which removed OOPBoT, its sign-in and OOPBoT\'s setup in Termux. Run the setup command in Termux again.
OOPBoT isn\'t set up in Termux yet. Run the setup command in Termux.
Termux\'s OOPBoT helper doesn\'t recognize this OOPBoT. Run the setup command in Termux again.
OOPBoT\'s helper isn\'t running in Termux. Open Termux, then switch back to OOPBoT.
Another app is using the ports OOPBoT\'s helper needs. Restart your phone, then retry.
